behavior: Covered verdicts require explicit individual requirements, quoted request/source basis and exact accepted-answer bindings
Explicit missing aspects override a contradictory overall covered status
Missing aspect descriptions and evidence hints feed the existing single revision
Evidence hints prioritize same-source candidates but cannot authorize another paper or version
Factual checker prompt requires resolving contrast and pronoun subjects
limits: Structural audit validation does not prove all semantically necessary aspects were enumerated
No real model validation of this new contract yet
